tasks.title: Define the HR dashboard and extensible filter contract
tasks.summary: After TASK-HR-001 is DONE, inspect the existing HR module, data model, permissions, and dashboard surfaces. Define dashboard acceptance criteria and an Elasticsearch-first filter contract for filter metadata/options, validated operators and values, sorting, pagination, and facets/aggregations. The dashboard must query an Elasticsearch HR read-model/index; adding a supported filter must not require adding a relational database column or changing the transactional database schema. Design a safe, extensible index document/mapping strategy for new searchable attributes (for example controlled dynamic templates or a typed attributes object), while preventing mapping explosion and arbitrary client-supplied query DSL. Document source-of-truth, ingestion/synchronization and freshness, mapping version/reindex strategy, authorization/PII controls, and unsupported-field behavior. Shape the HR index so it can later be exposed as a separately authorized RAG collection without coupling the dashboard to chatbot code; RAG implementation is not part of this task. Do not modify the Sima application in this design task.

tasks.title: v3.0 contract/DTO/schema + golden fixtures (schema invariance, nulls, pure JSON)
tasks.summary: Define strict TypeScript/JSON schema for v3.0 output (entity_id, trust_score, status, audit_summary, verified_facts, conflicts_detected, curated_knowledge_snippet). Create golden test fixtures covering: schema invariance (no extra/missing keys), null handling (null not omitted), pure JSON output (no markdown), banned hedging words (probable, likely, etc.), and boundary values for trust_score (0, 40, 75, 100).

tasks.title: Source authority hierarchy/normalization (tiers 1-4, weights 1.0/0.8/0.4/0.1, noise->0.1)
tasks.summary: Implement source classification into 4 tiers with weights: Tier 1 (1.0) = official hiring portals, government, corporate registries; Tier 2 (0.8) = LinkedIn, GitHub, technical docs; Tier 3 (0.4) = social media, forums, blogs; Tier 4 (0.1) = error pages, incomplete caches, spam/noise. Noise sources auto-weighted to 0.1. Normalize URLs/domains to tier. Unit tests for tier assignment and weight lookup.

tasks.title: Fact isolation into atomic claims (deterministic/validated boundary)
tasks.summary: Parse raw dossier into atomic claims: title, experience, skills, company, attributes. Each claim = {attribute, value, source_ref}. Deterministic parsing (no LLM). Validate boundary: empty input -> empty array; malformed source -> tier 4. Unit tests with golden fixtures.

tasks.title: Cross-validation + tier-4 filtering (verified if >=1 tier-1 or >=2 independent tier-2)
tasks.summary: Cross-validate claims across sources. Rule: claim verified if >=1 tier-1 source OR >=2 independent tier-2 sources. Tier-4 only -> discard as noise. Independence = distinct domains/origins. Output verified_facts with authority_weight and supporting_sources. Unit tests for verification logic and independence check.

tasks.title: Conflict resolution (higher-weight wins; tie -> audit; identity conflicts flagged)
tasks.summary: Resolve conflicting values for same attribute: higher tier weight wins; equal weight -> add to conflicts_detected with rationale (no guessing). Identity conflicts (entity_id mismatch) flagged as critical. Output conflicts_detected array with rejected_value, accepted_value, rationale. Unit tests for weight precedence, tie handling, identity conflict detection.

tasks.title: Scoring & status logic (0-100; APPROVED/REJECTED/NEEDS_MANUAL_AUDIT, boundary tests)
tasks.summary: Compute trust_score = weighted avg of verified facts (0-100 scale). Status: APPROVED if score>75 AND no unresolved key conflicts; REJECTED if score<40 OR critical identity conflict; NEEDS_MANUAL_AUDIT if 40-75 OR equal-weight conflicts in key fields. Key fields = identity, company, title. Unit tests at boundaries (39,40,75,76) and conflict scenarios.

tasks.title: Curated knowledge snippet, fact-only + banned-hedging filter
tasks.summary: Generate curated_knowledge_snippet: fact-only summary from verified_facts, no hedging. Ban words: probably, likely, possibly, may, might, could, appears, seems, suggests, indicates, presumably, allegedly, reportedly, supposedly. Validate snippet contains only verified fact language. Unit tests for hedging detection and fact-only output.

tasks.title: End-to-end orchestrator + hard constraints (no extrapolation, schema/null/pure JSON)
tasks.summary: Wire pipeline: isolate -> cross-validate -> resolve conflicts -> score -> snippet. Enforce hard constraints: (1) Zero extrapolation - reject any non-data output; (2) Schema invariance - exact keys, no extras; (3) Null handling - null for missing, never omit; (4) Pure JSON - no markdown, no commentary. Integration tests with golden fixtures covering all constraints.
